instrument: Final Plat, Compass Datacenters PHX II (Aug 17, 2026, item 4.17)
summary: Council approved the final plat for the multi-building Compass Datacenters PHX II facility on the consent agenda, 5-1.
text: Consideration and action to approve a Final Plat for Compass Datacenters PHX II in connection with the proposed multi-building facility located at the southwest corner of El Mirage Road and Peoria Avenue.

source.citation: City of El Mirage, Regular City Council Meeting Results, Aug 17, 2026

notes: Vote: Parsons/Winston, 5/1 (Nay: Gentry). Six voting. The same member voted nay on every item that remained on consent that night; do not characterize as a data-center-specific split.
